hero.prompt: A painterly editorial illustration of ordered earth at dusk — neat cultivated fields and terraced farmland stretching across the lower half of the frame under a vast sky, evoking Virgo's harvest precision and patient craft. Golden-green ordered rows fill the lower half; the upper sky carries a quicksilver Mercury sheen, cool silver-grey and clean and exact, blending upward into deep indigo and near-black. Palette of deep indigo to near-black (#16112c to #0b0a1b) with golden-green and silver accents. Calm, meticulous, refined atmosphere. Full-bleed wide 16:9 composition that fills the entire frame. ONE single continuous landscape scene, no split screen, no diptych, no two panels, no diagram, no chart wheel, no central framed card, no text or letters or numerals, no human faces
hero.altEn: Dusk over ordered terraced farmland under a cool silver Mercury sky blending into deep indigo, evoking Virgo's harvest precision
hero.altZh: 暮色中整齐的梯田农地，凉银水星天光与深靛色上空相融，唤起处女座的丰收精准与匠心
